title: Windows pinned to multiple virtual desktops, and in a different location on each due to tiling layouts, have outlines in an incorrect location on inactive virtual desktops
line: The Pager now draws a window pinned to several desktops at its own tiled position on each desktop instead of copying the active desktop's position into every cell.
explanation: KWin keeps a separate tile per virtual desktop, so a window on several desktops can sit in a different tile on each, but the plasma-window-management protocol only carried one geometry per window. libtaskmanager therefore had a single Geometry role and the Pager drew that same rectangle (the active desktop's) in every desktop cell, so the outlines were wrong on the other desktops and jumped on every switch. The change adds a virtual_desktop_geometry event (protocol v24) that KWin sends for each desktop where the window's geometry differs from its current one (its tile there, or its restore geometry when it's only tiled on the current desktop, mirroring what KWin does on a desktop switch); libtaskmanager exposes it as a VirtualDesktopGeometries role and the Pager uses it for each desktop's cell.

commits.message:
plasma-window-management: Add virtual_desktop_geometry event

A window on several virtual desktops can have a different geometry on
each of them when it's tiled differently there, but clients only knew
its current one. The new event tells them its geometry on the others.

CCBUG: 506056

wayland: Send window geometries on other virtual desktops

With per-desktop tiling a window on several desktops can sit in another
tile on each of them, but window management clients only got its current
geometry. Send the geometry it takes on each desktop where it differs.

CCBUG: 506056

libtaskmanager: Add VirtualDesktopGeometries role

A window tiled differently on each of its virtual desktops has another
geometry on each of them. Expose the geometries the compositor reports
for those desktops through a new VirtualDesktopGeometries role.

CCBUG: 506056

applets/pager: Show windows where they are on each desktop

A window on several desktops was drawn at its current position in every
desktop of the pager, even when it's tiled differently on the others.
Use the window's geometry on each desktop when the compositor knows it.

BUG: 506056

From ef7fbac9fc5d409661bd115d13a6b6f3fec887c6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:43:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasma-window-management: Add virtual_desktop_geometry event

A window on several virtual desktops can have a different geometry on
each of them when it's tiled differently there, but clients only knew
its current one. The new event tells them its geometry on the others.

CCBUG: 506056
---
 src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml | 22 +++++++++++++++++++---
 1 file changed, 19 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml b/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml
index b5a5565..9f9f36a 100644
--- a/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml
+++ b/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
   ]]></copyright>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window_management" version="23">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window_management" version="24">
     <description summary="application windows management">
       This interface manages application windows.
       It provides requests to show and hide the desktop and emits
@@ -127,7 +127,7 @@
     </request>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window" version="23">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window" version="24">
     <description summary="interface to control application windows">
       Manages and control an application window.
 
@@ -431,6 +431,22 @@
       </description>
       <arg name="resource_class" type="string" summary="resource class"/>
     </event>
+
+    <event name="virtual_desktop_geometry" since="24">
+      <description summary="The geometry of this window on a virtual desktop">
+        This event will be sent when the geometry the window has on the given
+        virtual desktop differs from its current geometry, for example because
+        the window is tiled differently on each virtual desktop it is on, and
+        whenever that geometry changes. A width and height of 0 mean the window
+        has its current geometry on that virtual desktop again.
+        The coordinates are in absolute coordinates of the windowing system.
+      </description>
+      <arg name="id" type="string" summary="the id of the virtual desktop"/>
+      <arg name="x" type="int" summary="x position of the org_kde_plasma_window"/>
+      <arg name="y" type="int" summary="y position of the org_kde_plasma_window"/>
+      <arg name="width" type="uint" summary="width of the org_kde_plasma_window"/>
+      <arg name="height" type="uint" summary="height of the org_kde_plasma_window"/>
+    </event>
   </interface>
 
   <interface name="org_kde_plasma_activation_feedback" version="1">
@@ -474,7 +490,7 @@
     </event>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_stacking_order" version="23">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_stacking_order" version="24">
     <description summary="helper object for sending the stacking order">
       When this object is created, the compositor sends a window event for
       each window in the stacking order, and afterwards sends the done event
--

review.text: The cross-project architecture (adding virtual_desktop_geometry to plasma-window-management, mirroring KWin's per-desktop tile/restore geometry, exposing VirtualDesktopGeometries in libtaskmanager, and consuming it in the Pager's WindowModel) is well-structured and the before/after media confirm it fixes the bug. However, the kwin and plasma-workspace patches do not apply on origin/master because they target an older v21 base and skip directly to v24, and KWin leaks stale virtual desktop IDs in virtualDesktopGeometries when desktops are removed. Those issues plus a couple of small robustness and test gaps should be fixed before opening MRs.
changes: Rebase the kwin and plasma-workspace commits onto origin/master so they bump s_version from 23 to 24 (instead of 21 to 24) and apply cleanly.

Clean up deleted virtual desktop IDs in PlasmaWindowInterfacePrivate::virtualDesktopGeometries (and notify clients with width/height 0), e.g., by connecting VirtualDesktopManager::desktopRemoved or passing the complete geometry map to PlasmaWindowInterface instead of only iterating existing desktops.

In PlasmaWindowInterfacePrivate::setVirtualDesktopGeometry, explicitly send 0, 0, 0, 0 when !geometry.isValid() rather than forwarding geometry.width()/geometry.height() (which could underflow uint32_t for non-null invalid rects).
Add a KWin Wayland autotest covering virtual_desktop_geometry updates, initial state, and virtual desktop removal.
